title: Great Circle Distance Calculator | OceanCalc
content: # Great Circle Distance Calculator. ## Great Circle Distance Calculator. ## What is the Great Circle Distance Calculator? Great Circle Distance Calculator applies familiar chart and piloting math in one place for deck and planning use. * Match input units to your chart, GPS, or instrument before trusting the Great Circle Distance Calculator. * ### How is great circle distance calculated? The haversine formula uses the latitudes and longitudes of both points to compute the central angle between them, then multiplies by Earth's radius (in nautical miles, about 3,440) to get distance. * ### Why use nautical miles for great circle? One nautical mile equals one minute of latitude, so great circle distance in nm relates directly to angular distance. The **great circle** is the closed circle deriving from the intersection of a sphere and a plane passing through the center of the sphere. The same holds if we consider the great circle passing through a point on the sphere's surface.
